_what_this_is: The retrieval corpus behind research/manuscripts/endpoint/emc-endpoint-alternatives.json and its findings note. It answers one question the repository had never asked: the 2025 IMMUNOSARC II EMC cohort tested a 6-month progression-free rate against H0 = 50% and H1 = 80%, and nothing in this repository recorded where those two numbers came from or whether they are appropriate for an indolent tumour. Answering it needed the soft-tissue-sarcoma progression-free-rate reference values and their derivation cohorts, both EMC trials' registered statistical designs, and the full texts of every EMC systemic-therapy report that might carry a fixed-timepoint progression rate.
_method: Two rounds. Round 1 is DISCOVERY: Europe PMC REST searches (resultType=core, so each hit carries its own PMID, DOI, journal and abstract) plus the two ClinicalTrials.gov v2 records, run against a question rather than against a guessed identifier — no PMID in this file was typed from memory and then looked up; every one below was READ OUT of a returned record. Round 2 is VERIFICATION: the PubMed Central full text of every EMC cohort whose 6-month or median progression figure the analysis depends on, because a figure carried in a committed artifact without a verbatim quote is a figure nobody has checked.
_dispatch: .github/workflows/fetch-literature.yml with targets_json=<the round object, underscore keys stripped>, targets_mode=replace, slug=<the round's slug>, ref=claude/paper-paths-emc-treatment-ad72sg. Dispatched at the working branch rather than main because the corpus is INLINE, so nothing in the fetch depends on the branch tree.
_a_key_here_is_a_filename_not_a_result: A name in this file records what was ASKED FOR. Whether the fetch succeeded, and with what HTTP status, is in each round's _manifest.json on the literature-cache branch. Read the manifest, never this file, for what was actually retrieved. One target in round 2 (epmc_ft_drilon_PMC2779719) returned HTTP 404 from the Europe PMC fullTextXML route and the same paper was recovered at HTTP 200 from pmc_html_drilon — which is why the ladder in that round runs two independent routes to the same document rather than one.

_rounds.emc-endpoint-benchmarks: round 1 (run 31271729241, success) — 43 discovery targets: the Van Glabbeke reference-value paper, growth-modulation-index and randomized-discontinuation-design methodology, Choi, tumour growth rate, time to next treatment, desmoid placebo arms as the nearest indolent-sarcoma calibration, EMC natural history, and the full registry records for NCT02066285 and NCT03277924.
_rounds.emc-endpoint-benchmarks-r2: round 2 (run 31271866210, success) — 16 verification targets: PubMed Central full texts for Drilon 2008, Stacchiotti 2013, Chiusole 2020, Morioka 2016, Liu 2020 and Remiszewski 2025, plus Crossref and PubMed cross-checks of the Van Glabbeke identifier and PubMed record counts for the two candidate designs.

_identifiers_returned_by_these_fetches._why_this_block_exists: Every identifier below was RETURNED BY one of the fetches above — a Europe PMC core record, a Crossref work record, a PubMed esearch id list or a ClinicalTrials.gov v2 study record — and none was assembled from a remembered journal or year. CLAUDE.md §7 records an agent writing a PMID from recollection that passed two gates; this block exists so that every identifier the findings note cites traces to a retrieval product rather than to a model's memory. ⚠ An identifier being anchored here is evidence that it was FETCHED, not that the claim attached to it is correct — the verbatim quotes that do that work live in emc_endpoint_alternatives.py beside the values they support.

11872347.what: Van Glabbeke 2002 — the soft-tissue-sarcoma progression-free-rate reference values

33203665.what: IMMUNOSARC I — the master trial whose published statistical section cites Van Glabbeke 2002 as reference 22

18951519.what: Drilon 2008 — the first EMC-specific 6-month progression-free benchmark, 40%

24345066.what: Stacchiotti 2013 — the second EMC-specific 6-month progression-free rate, 50%

32612944.what: Chiusole 2020 — its full text carries a 9-month median progression-free survival for first-line chemotherapy, which this repository had recorded as absent

41055792.journal: Journal of Cancer Research and Clinical Oncology
41055792.what: Remiszewski 2025 review — the EMC indolence figures quoted verbatim in E9

41321774.what: the only retrieved report of spontaneous regression of metastatic EMC — a single case, recorded because it is the whole of the direct evidence that untreated EMC metastases can regress

10913809.what: Mick 2000 — the paired-failure-time phase II design the growth modulation index operationalises

9607564.what: Von Hoff 1998 Rosenthal lecture — retrieved and confirmed to exist under this exact title; the 1.33 threshold is NOT in the retrieved abstract and is not attributed to it anywhere in this work

30458583.what: sample-size methodology for a phase II with the growth modulation index as primary endpoint

40156702.what: scoping review of how the growth modulation index is defined and reported, and how variably

23904460.what: Cousin 2013, French Sarcoma Group — growth modulation index in 227 pretreated soft-tissue-sarcoma patients, and an independent restatement of the EORTC-STBSG activity cut-offs

33672857.what: Martinez-Trufero 2021, GEISTRA — growth modulation index in 357 advanced soft-tissue-sarcoma patients on trabectedin

37542912.what: growth modulation index evaluated against a randomized phase III sequence trial — the only retrieved randomised check on the index

12431972.what: Rosner/Stadler/Ratain — the randomized discontinuation design, proposed expressly to separate drug effect from indolent disease

15983399.what: power evaluation of the randomized discontinuation design against upfront randomisation

17008711.what: Problems with the randomized discontinuation design — retrieved at title level, no abstract returned

19636018.what: a second power comparison of the randomized discontinuation design

30575484.what: Gounder 2018 — sorafenib versus placebo in desmoid tumours, the only retrieved randomised placebo-controlled measurement of the natural-history component of a progression-based endpoint in an indolent soft-tissue tumour

42052362.what: Singapore desmoid series — the only retrieved untreated-cohort fixed-timepoint progression rate for any indolent soft-tissue tumour (14 of 19 progression-free at 12 months on active surveillance)

_counts_returned_that_are_themselves_rea.what_these_are_for: Both candidate instruments are real but thinly used. A count of PubMed records is a crude measure of how established a method is and is reported as one — it is not a quality judgement, and it was retrieved rather than estimated.

_what_was_searched_for_and_not_found.an_untreated_or_observation_arm_emc_prog: Searched three ways (epmc_emc_untreated_metastases, epmc_emc_indolent_naturalhistory, epmc_emc_time_to_metastasis). Nothing returned reports a fixed-timepoint progression rate for advanced EMC patients receiving no systemic therapy. The nearest returned item is a single 2025 case report of spontaneous regression after palliative surgery. This is a MEASURED ABSENCE across the queries listed, not a claim that no such data could exist anywhere.
_what_was_searched_for_and_not_found.a_choi_criteria_reading_of_any_emc_cohor: Searched twice (epmc_choi_vs_recist_sarcoma, epmc_choi_nongist). Nothing returned reports a Choi response assessment of an EMC cohort, although Choi is a registered outcome measure of both EMC trials.
_what_was_searched_for_and_not_found.an_emc_growth_modulation_index_series: Searched twice (epmc_gmi_any, epmc_gmi_sarcoma). The two sarcoma series returned are soft-tissue-sarcoma-wide and neither states an EMC patient.
_what_was_searched_for_and_not_found.a_van_glabbeke_full_text: The Europe PMC core record reports isOpenAccess: N and no open-access full text was retrieved, so the derivation cohorts are known only to the extent the abstract names them. Whether the 1154 non-pretreated patients included any EMC is therefore UNSETTLED and is stated as unsettled wherever it matters.
_what_was_searched_for_and_not_found.a_desmoid_nirogacestat_record: TITLE:"Nirogacestat in Progressing Desmoid Tumors" returned hitCount 0 from Europe PMC. Only the sorafenib randomised trial was retrieved, so the calibration in E10 rests on one randomised study rather than two.
